title: knowledge-pgvector: the live PostgreSQL mount case drops `adapter` and `requires`, so it exercises the deployment store and the item mount
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP

Filing gate: ① follow-up of PR #38026 (#37306; contract review N2 / N10 — PostgreSQL acceptance is not measured end to end) · Source: topic #37000
Grading: area:ai · Test · p3 (suggested: two unit pins already compose to the line; this closes the end-to-end gap) · reach: every PostgreSQL deployment that writes a `knowledge_source` without `adapter` · evidence: read of `packages/plugins/knowledge-pgvector/src/__tests__/capability-mount.live-postgres.test.ts` on main 6e2a8f2bb5 and of PR #38026's Acceptance notes.
Dedupe: `is:issue live-postgres knowledge adapter` → 12 (open: #37306 — the parent change, #37974 — hybrid search; none on this test) · `is:issue capability-mount live postgres knowledge` → 3 (open: #37306 only).
Reader: area o1-C of seat repo:objectstack#1 claims it after triage's first touch.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：#38026 让知识源可以不写存储、也不必声明需要知识服务；但 CI 里唯一连真实 PostgreSQL 的用例仍写了 `adapter: 'pgvector'` 和 `requires: ['knowledge']`，所以这两件新行为在真实 PostgreSQL 上没有被端到端测到，只靠两个单元测试拼起来。
- 做什么：在这个真实 PostgreSQL 用例里加一个不写 `adapter`、不写 `requires` 的知识源，确认它被挂载、写进 pgvector 并能检索到。
- 谁受益：所有在 PostgreSQL 上用知识检索的部署。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
`capability-mount.live-postgres.test.ts` names `adapter: 'pgvector'` and `requires: ['knowledge']`, so it exercises neither the omitted adapter (the source binds to the deployment's marked store) nor the item mount (a `knowledge_source` item alone mounts the service). What pins #37306's PostgreSQL line today is two unit pins composed: `resolveCapabilityArgument('knowledge', postgres)` answers `{ deploymentAdapter: 'pgvector' }` (core), and a source with no adapter binds to the marked store (service-knowledge).

What: add a live case (or a second stack in the same file) whose stack ships a `knowledge_source` with no `adapter` and lists no `knowledge` token, boots against the live PostgreSQL, and asserts the service is mounted, the source's passages land in the pgvector tables, and a search returns them. Keep the existing explicit case as the control.

## Acceptance
- With `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` set, the new case boots, builds and searches through pgvector with neither `adapter` nor `requires` written.
- Removing the item mount or the deployment-store mark turns it red (ablation named in the PR).
- The existing explicit case still passes.

Blocked-by: #37306
